answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1276 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the cipher. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the anchor queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. The wander index is deterministic from ledger replay, and thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 31 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
